title: v4.2.0 · 旧版 PHP 运行时迁移技能
highlights: Add in-house devops-sre/legacy-php-runtime-migration: replace end-of-life host PHP with vendor-patched builds or same-path containers without changing code, nginx, cron or paths
Entry covers patch evidence, inventory, effective-config parity, side-by-side FastCGI checks, staged cutover with rollback and post-cutover verification
References cover 32 field-tested pitfalls, verification commands, nginx binary hot upgrade and production safety rules
Content is original and anonymized: no hosts, addresses, business names or amounts
Archive the v4.1.0 changelog section from its tag
release_gates: Exact PR head and merged-main Repository Validation, provenance and CodeQL pass
Zero open Code Scanning alerts on main before publishing
Complete repository validation and generator idempotence pass
Downloaded source/npm archives, manifest and SHA256SUMS match the exact merged-main commit

validation_boundaries.runtime: The method was exercised on two test and two production hosts; the skill text itself is checked statically (quality, instructions, provenance, tests), not by model evaluations.
validation_boundaries.security: Patch status in the examples stays UNVERIFIED (vendor changelog only); the skill does not certify vulnerability fixes.
validation_boundaries.upstream: No upstream sources were synchronized in this release.

compatibility_notes: Adds one canonical skill path, skills/devops-sre/legacy-php-runtime-migration; existing skill names and the installer CLI are unchanged
README release blurbs are not extended, following the README edit on main that removed them
